annotations.title: Start a photo mosaic on collager.ai

description: Gives the link where the user builds a photo mosaic: one main photo recreated from many small photos (best with 100-2000 photos - family archive, wedding, team, school year). The user uploads the photos on collager.ai, picks the style, and the site builds a watermarked preview in minutes. Use when the user wants a photo mosaic or a picture made of many photos.

occasion.description: Optional: what it is for (anniversary, memorial, wedding, team ...), used only to tailor the tips.
